items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: The name 'Anatole Litbox' is mentioned by the [INTERVIEWER] in a promotional script for a TV show; the [INTERVIEWEE] does not speak or respond to this mention.

ctx.x: I'm biding my time. Next year, next year, something's bound to happen. This year, this year, I'm going to keep on in that morning biding my time. I want a steady water, body my time. Next Sunday night, Ingrid Bergman, Yves Montand, and Tony Perkins. Headline R show in a movie scene from Anatole Litbox, Goodbye Again, which should be a tremendous hit. A love story in which Ingrid Bergman loves Parisian playboy Yves Montand, and is comforted by the youthful Tony Perkins when Montand becomes indifferent.
